text:
Sarah: quick RFC follow-up: pick a default for tenant private connectivity. direct endpoint in customer VPC vs our tenant-proxy. want clear default + failover semantics.

Matt: constraints from product: predictable tail latency, simple onboarding (partner ACLs), and clear cost signals.

Oliver: direct = lowest latency + preserves source IP for partner ACLs. downside = large number of cross-account endpoints and more peering maintenance.

Devon: proxy centralizes telemetry and makes caching/batching easy; allows graceful rollouts. downside = extra hop and ops surface.

Priya: SRE note: with direct we have no automatic fallback if customer route changes. proxy gives a safe fallback path.

Sarah: proposal: default = prefer direct when healthy, auto-fail to proxy on health/latency errors. allow explicit direct-only or proxy-only flags per customer (eg compliance, partner requirements).

Matt: propose numeric thresholds to start: prefer direct if sustained <200 rps and <5k tokens/min; recommend proxy when >200 rps sustained or customer requests caching.

Oliver: failure detect idea: if proxy p95 >120ms for 20s OR proxy error rate >2% for 1m, then fail to direct when available. also circuit-break proxy when saturated.

Devon: routing config sketch:
```yaml
connectivity:
  default: prefer_direct_with_proxy_fallback
  direct_threshold_rps: 200
  proxy_fail_latency_ms: 120
  proxy_fail_window_s: 20
  forced_direct_tags: ["egress-ip-preservation", "partner-acl"]
  proxy_only_tags: ["data-residency"]
```

Priya: ops items: tag traces path=direct|proxy, include proxy instance id, dashboards for split rates and p95 per path, autoscale with 30% headroom, runbook for proxy->direct failover.

Sarah: cert modes to support: (1) mTLS end-to-end with proxy as TCP passthrough, (2) TLS terminate at proxy + attestation token. document tradeoffs in appendix.

Matt: sales/solutions want cost comparison (infra vs ops) included in decision doc.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-3499: "Tenant connectivity default: prefer-direct-with-proxy-fallback" assigned to Sarah, Devon, Oliver, Priya, Matt.

Sarah: action items: i'll draft decision appendix with thresholds; Devon+Oliver will run capacity sims; Priya will draft failover runbook. reconvene Fri. :thumbsup:
